entries.title: Nothing wrong?
entries.text: Approve it, then hand the papers back.

entries.title: Pull up the record
entries.text: Drag the student ID onto the ISMIS reader, or press S. No card? Type their number into the search box.

entries.title: Flagging
entries.text: Click a field on the papers, then the same field on ISMIS. Flags are checked when you decide. False alarms cost patience.

entries.title: Wrong calls
entries.text: A wrong call sends the student back angrier. Two wrong calls and they walk out.

entries.title: Priority
entries.text: GRAD and PWD students can be called out of turn from the line.

entries.title: Short forms
entries.text: Ma. for Maria, J. for Juan, BS IT for BSIT. These are fine. Don't flag them.

entries.title: Two problems?
entries.text: Turn-aways come first, then the Cashier, then the other offices, then fixes at the window.

entries.title: Missing requirement
entries.text: Every clearance item must be attached. Missing one? Turn away: Missing requirement, and tick exactly what they need to bring.

entries.title: Full section
entries.text: Fix: open the section picker. Choose an open section that doesn't clash with their week.

entries.title: Open market
entries.text: Seats drop while the picker is open. Don't take too long.

entries.title: Unpaid balance
entries.text: Any balance in ISMIS? Route: Cashier first. They come back with a receipt.

entries.title: Locked account
entries.text: Fix: open the reset tool. Type their number, confirm the ID and birthday, print the temporary password.

entries.title: Birthday doesn't match
entries.text: If the admission slip's birthday isn't the one in ISMIS, it isn't their account. Turn away: Details don't match the record.

entries.title: Failed prerequisite
entries.text: A 5.0 in the prerequisite (Grades tab)? Turn away: Failed prerequisite.

entries.title: INC in the prerequisite
entries.text: An INC goes to their adviser. Route: Consultation.

entries.title: No signature
entries.text: Adding a subject needs the adviser's signature. Blank? Route: Consultation.

entries.title: Fake signature
entries.text: Compare it with the specimen on the Advisers tab. Doesn't match? Turn away: Fake signature.

entries.title: Check before routing
entries.text: Look at an office's status first. Sending someone to a closed office is a wasted trip.

entries.title: On break
entries.text: Office on break? Hold them on the bench (3 seats). They go as soon as it reopens.

entries.title: Overload
entries.text: Over 24 units? Route: Dean's office.

entries.title: Closed for the day
entries.text: The office won't reopen today? Turn away: Office closed today, come back tomorrow.
